summary: Sparkfund comments on MISO's informational report to show that distributed batteries and other distributed resources already supply capacity to integrate large loads, citing Xcel Energy's Capacity*Connect program in Minnesota.

points.point: Sparkfund says aggregators and utilities in MISO can deploy distributed resources as capacity today under existing participation models.
points.quote: aggregators and utilities within MISO are able to deploy distributed resources as capacity today using the existing participation models.

points.point: Minnesota approved Xcel's Capacity*Connect: up to 200 MW of distribution-sited batteries by the end of 2028, with potential for 500 MW by 2031.
points.quote: to deploy up to 200 MW of front-of-the-meter, distribution-sited 1-3 MW battery energy storage systems (BESS) by the end of 2028

points.point: Google's Pine Island, MN agreement includes $50 million toward the battery portfolio for matched capacity credits.
points.quote: Google’s new Pine Island, MN data center facility has entered an Electric Service Agreement that includes $50 million towards Xcel’s Capacity*Connect battery portfolio

points.point: Xcel's compliance filing shows average residential savings of about $0.13 per month, rising to about $0.17 with Google's contribution.
points.quote: Capacity*Connect will deliver average residential bill savings of approximately $0.13 per month over the twenty-year analysis period

points.point: Sparkfund says several utilities each deploying 200-500 MW could total gigawatts in MISO.
points.quote: multiple utilities deploying 200-500 MW of utility-owned and operated distributed capacity could amount to gigawatts across the MISO footprint

throughLine.text: Comments on MISO's July 20 informational report, which answers the E-8 directive to explain how MISO will ensure adequate generation for large loads; Sparkfund offers distributed capacity as a supply source.

figures.label: Xcel Capacity*Connect distributed batteries by end of 2028
figures.quote: up to 200 MW of front-of-the-meter, distribution-sited 1-3 MW battery energy storage systems

figures.quote: includes $50 million towards Xcel’s Capacity*Connect battery portfolio
